item.title: Bennett outlines conditions for unity government led by Eisenkot
item.description: Former PM Naftali Bennett pledges to form a Zionist unity government led by Gadi Eisenkot, but rules out joining Netanyahu. He outlines three principles for the next government, warning Likud not to waste the 29 days left in Eisenkot's mandate.

item.title: Bnei Akiva unveils new 'tribe' name: Shevet Kedem
item.description: Bnei Akiva's annual activity month announces new name for members of Shevet Haro'eh: 'Kedem.' Chosen by movement leaders at the late Rabbi Chaim Druckman's home, it reflects Jewish roots, Torah, unity & responsibility for building the nation & state.

item.title: The Holocaust was not an instance of colonialism
item.description: Holocaust distortion is not merely false. It is morally obscene-an assault not only on the dead, but on truth itself. The hatred that marked Jews for destruction is not just an episode in the general history of persecution. Opinion.
